caption: This drawing features two distinct objects on a plain, beige-colored background. In the upper portion, there is a roughly circular, hazy brown patch with a blue butterfly in the center, drawn with dark blue and lighter blue tones; above the butterfly, partially legible, there is text reading "JULIUS NORTO..." and a vertical, thin, brownish mark to the right of the butterfly. In the lower portion of the drawing, there is a simple, clean-outline depiction of a jug with a handle, drawn in blue ink; a small form resembling a butterfly, also outlined in blue, is positioned on the left side of the jug. In the bottom left corner, the name "FUMAGALLI" is written in stylized letters.
title: Jug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
